composition_rules: Resolve preflight blockers before any teardown.
Expand exact referenced step ranges in phase order; never execute a whole remove/refit guide before interior work.
Do not mark omitted source steps complete; mark them outside this phase or NOT_PERFORMED.
Re-evaluate physical entry/exit states at every phase boundary; matching part names alone do not close a dependency.
A failed inspection requires the documented replacement/repair route and cannot be bypassed by saving a note.
Preserve required observation/timing/torque records; routine checks remain Checked.
This index cannot by itself certify a complete engine rebuild.

routes.scope: Exact stock top-end removal/inspection/reseal/rebuild where original valves/guides/seats remain serviceable; cylinder/piston set replacement supported with actual-fit checks.
preflight: Review head-service replacement/machining contingency before opening.
Obtain correct new seals/gaskets/clips and measuring tools.
Configured exact YDT with its supplied operation instructions is an equipment prerequisite for final temperature/idle check.
